summary: @servicetitan/titan-chatbot-ui-cypress preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` hook `node setup.mjs`. `setup.mjs` is obfuscator.io-style code (`_0x`-prefixed identifiers, per-call literal maps) that downloads the Bun runtime zip from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/...zip`, extracts it, chmods it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, ['math_init.js'])`. The sibling `math_init.js` is a 727KB heavily obfuscated `@bun @bun-cjs` bundle with a shuffled string-array + rotation decoder (`WV8StW`, `hc1jfK9`, `n7gIxM` constant array) — its behavior is not inspectable by Node-level tooling. The package is advertised as a Cypress helper for ServiceTitan's Titan Chat UI (CHANGELOG references `github.com/servicetitan/titan-chatbot-client`), but the shipped install-time behavior is unrelated to Cypress testing, matching the shape of a scope-squat / dependency-confusion drop against the `@servicetitan` scope. Installing this package auto-executes an opaque obfuscated payload on the installer's machine via an alternate runtime, bypassing Node-based integrity and scanner tooling.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
